description: This file is a frontend component for a Tic Tac Toe game platform built with Qwik. It implements a navigation bar with links, user state management, and logout functionality.

methods.name: Navbar
methods.description: A Qwik component for rendering the navigation bar with user login/logout features.

methods.name: handleLogout
methods.description: An event handler that logs out the user and redirects to the home page.
